(()=>{const t=document.querySelector('.alteration-stage-content input:not([type="checkbox"])');if(!t)throw Error('Stage reference input missing');Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(t,'Reviewed Stage Coordination Set S01');t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));const c=document.querySelector('.alteration-stage-confirm input');if(!c.checked)c.click();return true})()
(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='Review stage geometry');if(!b)throw Error('Review stage geometry button missing');b.click();return true})()

(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('.alteration-issue-modal-card button')].find(btn=>btn.textContent.includes('Issue & Freeze'));if(!b)throw Error('Issue & Freeze button missing');b.click();return true;})()

(()=>{const t=document.querySelector('.alteration-stage-content input:not([type="checkbox"])');if(t){Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(t,'Reviewed Stage Coordination Set S02');t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));const c=document.querySelector('.alteration-stage-confirm input');if(!c.checked)c.click();const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(btn=>btn.textContent.trim()==='Review stage geometry');if(b)b.click();}return true})()
